text:
Aria Kim: Heads-up: starter-kit sampleapp failing schema validation on CI. When calling fn-call with json_mode, fields typed as nullable arrays (e.g. tags) come back as [] after an auth retry instead of null.

Ravi Desai: Is this JS or Python?

Aria Kim: Repro in JS but likely parity issue. Minimal call: 
```js
await redwood.sdk.callFunction({ name: 'note.update', arguments: { tags: null }, jsonMode: true })
// force 401 on first attempt to trigger auth refresh
```
Second attempt payload has tags: []

Build Bot: CI job #523 failed: sample-app/schema-e2e expected null got array :warning:

Ravi Desai: Sounds like serialize->deserialize path during retry normalizes missing/None to empty array. We had a normalization step for collection types.

Aria Kim: Workaround for now: in sample app, run a tiny sanitizer before calling SDK: if field schema says nullable and value is empty array -> set null. Ugly but stops CI red.

Yvonne Park: We should add a small test in SDK that simulates an auth refresh and asserts original nulls are preserved. Also document this behavior in starter-kit troubleshooting.

Ravi Desai: I'll open a PR adding a preserveNulls flag to the serializer and unit tests. Also will file a followup to sync Python/JS parity.

Aria Kim: Thanks — I'll add the hotfix sanitizer to the sampleapp README and the quick CI patch.

Build Bot: Issue created: DEVEX-1155 "retry serialization: nullable arrays coerced to empty arrays" assigned to Ravi Desai :bug:
